settings.heading: Delivery & returns
settings.content: Free tracked UK delivery on every order, typically arriving in 7–10 working days — we email the tracking link as soon as it ships. If it's not right, return it within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. No restocking fee, no forms.

settings.heading: Using & caring for it
settings.content: Place it at your prayer space before you begin, and sit for as much of the prayer as your body needs that day. The curved runners sit flat on carpet without marking it. Wipe the seat with a damp cloth when needed — that's the whole routine. For how and when to sit during salah in your situation, your local imam is the right person to ask.

settings.heading: Will it suit me?
settings.content: The Sakina Prayer Stool is a low, padded seat on a welded steel alloy frame — made for the sitting portions of salah, or the whole prayer if you need it. It weighs just 1.2kg, so it moves easily between home and the masjid. The seat is firm padding with a wipe-clean cover, in warm tan or classic black. If you'd like the exact seat dimensions or weight rating before ordering, message us and we'll confirm the same day.
